insights.summary: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue was ₹572 Cr (+8% YoY) with EBITDA ₹110 Cr (19.2%) and PAT ₹64 Cr; standalone revenue grew 10% to ₹559 Cr. Management cut FY27 growth guidance to 25% (from 35-40%), blaming low utilisation while Changodar is expanded, now due from August 2026. Order inflow was strong at ₹2,114 Cr, including a ₹1,000 Cr+ PGCIL order, taking the order book to ₹6,630 Cr.

what_changed.text: FY27 revenue growth guidance cut to 25% from 35-40% (about ₹3,250 Cr) on the April call
Changodar expansion now from August 2026, stabilising in Q3; backward integration plants staged Q2 FY27 to Q1 FY28
Order book up 26% YoY to ₹6,630 Cr after ₹2,114 Cr of Q1 orders, including an Ultra Mega PGCIL order above ₹1,000 Cr
The US$1 billion goal restated as ₹7,000-8,000 Cr by FY29
EY appointed for investor relations; management promised to guide only what it is confident of

tone.label: cautious
tone.quote: we are committed to providing only those guidance parameters that we are confident of achieving

analyst_questions.answer: Low utilisation at Changodar during expansion; Moraiya only 57-65% utilised, partly on raw-material constraints.
16% is standalone including other income; consolidated was 19.2% in Q1, with the CFO saying 20-21% and later about +100 bps over standalone.
No plan to raise debt; capex funded by ₹145 Cr of QIP money, about ₹500 Cr of leasing and internal accruals; target 120-130 working-capital days.
Inventory stocked up to December 2026 until backward integration plants start.

red_flags.text: Third guidance cut in a row: FY27 growth now 25%, down from 35-40% three months ago.
Mixed growth messages on the same call: 25% guided, but 30% growth mentioned later.
Utilisation is low across plants: Changodar 27% in Q1, Moraiya 57%.
Inventory deliberately raised to December 2026; net working capital about 170 days in FY26.
Conflicting consolidated margin guidance (20-21% vs about 17%).

watch_next: Changodar expansion running from August and utilisation improving in Q2-Q3
CTC plant commissioned in Q2 FY27
Inventory and working capital days coming down

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Transformers from 33 kV to 1,200 kV (power, distribution, IGT, reactors); building CTC, pressboard, bushing, fabrication and CRGO units in-house
business_snapshot.customers: PGCIL, state utilities (GETCO, RRVPNL), EPC contractors, private and export customers (USA)
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Exports 10-15% of revenue; inquiries ₹23,000 Cr, about 80% domestic and 20% export
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Grid modernisation, renewables integration, data centres, railway electrification and EV charging
